parts.label: a
parts.text: Check whether the functions f(x)=x^2 and g(x)=e^{log x} are linearly independent or not for x>0. Support your answer with proper reasoning.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Construct the general solution of the differential equation x y'' + 3y' - 4y = 0 where D ≡ d/dx.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Using proper substitution, transform the Cauchy‑Euler differential equation x^2 y'' - x y' + 2 y = 0 (x>0) into the form d^2 y/dt^2 + p dy/dt + q y = 0 with t as the independent variable, where p and q are constants. Determine the values of p and q.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Develop the general solution of the differential equation y'' - 3y' + 96 e^{x} y = 0 using the method of variation of parameters.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Identify and classify the singular point(s) of the differential equation y'' + (1/x) y' + (2/x) y = 0 on the x‑axis.

parts.label: b
parts.text: For the differential equation y'' + (2/x) y' + (2/x^2) y = 0 determine its general solution in the form y = Σ_{n=0}^{∞} a_n x^{n} + Σ_{n=0}^{∞} b_n x^{n+1} where a_0 and b_0 are arbitrary constants.

parts.label: a
parts.text: For the Legendre polynomial P_n(x) of order n prove that (i) P_n(1)=1 and (ii) (1−x^2) P'_n(x) = n [P_{n-1}(x) - x P_n(x)].

parts.label: b
parts.text: Define the expression of the Bessel function J_n(x) in terms of the gamma function. Hence, derive d/dx [x^{−n} J_n(x)] = -x^{−n} J_{n+1}(x).

parts.label: a
parts.text: State the definition to find the Laplace transform of any function f(t) for t≥0. Hence, apply it to compute the Laplace transform of f(t)=2t e^{t}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Using properties, determine the Laplace transform of the function F(t)= (2t) e^{t} - 1.
